content: On invocation of StbM_Start Time r for a Time Notification Customer of a Time Base the StbM shall calculate the time CustomerTimerExpireTime when that Customer Timer will expire based on the corresponding Time Base. If a Customer Timer for the same Customer is already running, StbM_StartTimer shall return E_NOT_OK .
